name: Hunter Rise
summary: Hunters and warriors gather on Hunter Rise, the southern mesa of Thunder Bluff. Its platforms give tauren hunters, trackers, skinners, and warriors room to train and prepare for battle.

sections.title: The Gathering of Braves
sections.body: Rope bridges link Hunter Rise to the neighboring bluffs of Thunder Bluff. At its center, the Hunter's Hall is where seasoned marksmen, trackers, and warriors teach the young. Practice grounds around the hall hold training dummies, weapon racks, and skinning posts. Here, tauren learn the skills needed to wield spear and bow and work hides.

sections.title: Martial Duty and Defense
sections.body: Hunter Rise's people hunt across the plains of Mulgore and help defend Thunder Bluff and the wider Horde. Battlemasters stationed along the rise recruit seasoned fighters for skirmishes against Alliance incursions across contested battlegrounds. Those sworn to protect the herd gather here when the Horde needs them.

aliases: how to get to hunter rise
faq.answer: Hunter Rise lies on the southern side of Thunder Bluff. Rope bridges connect it to the city's lower rise and high rise mesas.

faq.q: Who lives and trains on Hunter Rise?
faq.answer: Tauren hunters, warriors, trackers, trappers, and leatherworkers live and train on the mesa. Class and profession trainers teach here, and Horde battlemasters recruit fighters for the faction's wars.
The Hunter's Hall is the main longhouse on Hunter Rise, where seasoned hunters and warriors gather. It is an armory and school for those learning tracking, marksmanship, and close combat.

faq.q: Can members of the Alliance visit Hunter Rise?
aliases: can alliance go to hunter rise
faq.answer: No. Thunder Bluff is a major Horde capital, and seasoned tauren braves guard Hunter Rise. City guards attack Alliance adventurers who try to cross its bridges.

angles.text: As a young tauren hunter, you can find training, pet supplies, and guidance from master trackers on Hunter Rise, the heart of your calling in the capital.
Hunter Rise's grounds offer training dummies, combat mentors, and battlemasters ready to test your strength as you help defend the Horde.
